meta.title: How to Sharpen a Knife with a Whetstone | Kenji's Cooking Show
meta.description:
Hey folks, here's a video showing you my technique for knife sharpening. my buddy Barney stopped by with some of his new knives, which I really enjoy. You can get them here: https://kankitchen.com/

(As always,  I don't receive anything from those knife sales, and I never do any kind of paid sponsorships or paid endorsements of any kind.)
chapters: set the angle of your knife
start with the heel at the top of the stone
use one hand on the blade to apply pressure
